notes:
**Set Keen up on your Mac, connect your iPhone, and approve Keen's changes right in the chat.** Keen 0.37.0 guides you through setup, shows a QR code for Keen on iPhone when you use Keen Cloud, asks on a card in the conversation before a change that needs your OK, and lets you talk to the chat as well as type.

## Getting started

- **Setup guides you.** It asks where your notes live, This Mac only or Keen Cloud (Mac and iPhone; Keen Cloud needs an invite), then walks you through getting an Anthropic key. Click Save and check, and Keen tests the key there and then.
- **Connect your iPhone with a QR code.** First install Keen on iPhone from your TestFlight invitation. With Keen Cloud, open Settings › Connections › Use Keen on your iPhone, click Connect an iPhone and unlock, then scan the code with your iPhone's camera. On your own server, Keen shows the server's address and an access code to enter in Keen on iPhone instead.

## Approving Keen's changes

- **Keen asks on a card in the chat**, where you asked for the change, in the main window, the floating window and an item's chat panel. Click its buttons, or press ⌘. to decline; most cards also take ⌘↩ to approve. A card that needs a click says so.
- **Type yes or no.** With the card showing, typing just "yes" or "no" in the chat box answers it too, on a server at 0.37.0 (which this version needs). A card that needs a click still needs one.

## Chat by keyboard, pointer or voice

- **Add and Send.** The chat box in the main window and the floating window has Add, for a file or image, a task, a project or a knowledge item, and Send.
- **Dictate.** In the same chat boxes, click Dictate or press ⌘D and speak. It needs macOS Dictation turned on; if it's off, Keen says so and points you to the setting. The first time, macOS asks you to allow the microphone and speech recognition. Your speech is turned into text on this Mac, and you can edit it before you send.

## Pickers

- **Pickers open for the item a command named**, on Summary and in Related lists too. Add Tag… is in a task row's right-click menu, and every picker names the item it changes at the top.

---

**Self-hosted servers: update yours.** This version of Keen needs a server at 0.37.0 or newer. A self-hosted server below that is blocked until it is updated: follow "Update to a new backend version" in the Self-Hosting Runbook, which uses `./scripts/update-remote.sh`.

**Updating:** Keen updates itself. You'll be prompted on next launch, or check Settings › General › Updates.

**Managed servers:** this release updates the backend too. If you're on a managed server, Keen updates it before restarting (usually a minute or two). If it can't, it asks you after the restart.
